title: Stark Warning – Could a New Scene in 'Avengers: Endgame' Reveal the Truth About Doctor Doom?
seoTitle: New Endgame Scene & the Doctor Doom Mystery
subtitle: Four short additions push the film to the top of the box office, but the ones truly celebrating are Disney's accountants.
excerpt: Four extra scenes make 'Avengers: Endgame' the highest-grossing movie in history, raising questions about what they truly reveal.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Warning: contains spoilers

Four short scenes were added to the re-release of Avengers: Endgame, pushing the film to the title of highest-grossing movie of all time. The only group that seems to genuinely enjoy this milestone are Disney's accountants.

Then comes the question: do these additions reveal anything about the character Doctor Doom? The phrase suggests a "Stark warning," inviting audiences to rethink what is known about the villain in the cinematic universe.

Meanwhile, the question persists: does it really matter who holds the title of highest-grossing film? The recap even raises the possibility that James Cameron might be lying awake at night, stewing over Avatar being replaced by Endgame at the top of the box office charts as if it were a personal insult.

With information from The Guardian.
